scope:
Explicit median-carbon 128-zone integration, with two receiver mass scenarios.

Only declared stage records are loaded. Raw extraction and reduced-input replay
are separate. Uses unchanged actual-composition material, receiver and plant APIs.

comparison.nuclear_rate_mode: updated median carbon capture pairs; other190 original rates
comparison.source_preparation: prescribed hot profiles; no source-mapped variant

plant.scope: Conditional stationary heat/power/mass requirements. Hot eligibility, insulation, converter/HX/pump ratings and cold-sky view require hardware qualification. Original generic services retained; named HX and pump hardware are incremental allocations.
plant.surface_proxy_scope: Sum of separate maxima in constant-property carbon; prompt mathematical-surface deposition is an intentionally conservative reference, not a qualified physical temperature. Finite spectral penetration and delayed heat require separate treatment.
plant.processing_cost_scope: These named H-processing loads are compared with the retained ordinary-auxiliary allowance; they are not additional debits on top of an allowance already intended to cover processing. New requirements exceeding that allowance must be added explicitly.
plant.qualification: Conditional integrated accounting point. Source formation, receiver recovery and guide/thermal hardware remain engineering candidates.

qualification: Conditional integrated accounting; grey-opacity spherical source, collector and hardware assumptions retain their separate limitations. Exact eventual material return is a closed-reservoir accounting case, not perfect first-pass extraction. Omitted .1% tails remain retained and routed; main-window occupancy is not complete material clearance.
